about: on a touch device focus is drawn only after a key event reaches handle_event, even one that gives nil, nil, and stops after any pointer event while focus itself is kept; ui:focus does not change it (probe-confirmed); the keyless records simulate a device with no touch input by setting ctx.input.pointer = false around create, a lever that only inkemu has (its library reads the field at create): such an object draws focus from its first frame, and a pointer event turns that off too
